name_en: Amenoio gohan — rice cooked whole with Lake Biwa trout
summary_ja: 産卵のため川を遡上する琵琶湖固有種ビワマスを丸ごと米にのせて炊き込むご飯。「あめのいお」は雨の魚の意で、身と卵をほぐして混ぜ込む食べ方が秋の大鍋料理として伝わる。
summary_en: A whole Lake Biwa trout, migrating upstream to spawn, is set atop rice and cooked together; "amenoio" means "rain fish," a name tied to the trout's autumn run after rainfall. The flesh and roe are flaked and mixed through the rice, traditionally made in large pots for gatherings.
source_title: あめのいおご飯 滋賀県

name_en: Shoi meshi — soy-seasoned rice cooked with root vegetables
summary_ja: ごぼうや人参、干ししいたけ、油揚げをだし汁と醤油で煮て、そこに米を加えて炊き上げる高島市新旭地域の料理。祭りの際に食べられてきたことから「わっしょい」にちなむ説など、名の由来には諸説あるという。
summary_en: Burdock, carrot, dried shiitake, and fried tofu are simmered in dashi and soy sauce before rice is added and cooked through, a specialty of the Shinasahi area of Takashima. Traditionally eaten at festivals, its name is said to echo the festival chant "wasshoi," among other theories.
source_title: しょいめし 滋賀県
